content: Although both these tweets are from the same account, we assert that Tweet 1 sounds more characteristic of Donald Trump than Tweet 2. We might also guess that the first is more popular than second. Indeed, Tweet 1 received 155,000 likes as opposed to only 234 for Tweet 2.
